2200: from ζέω; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively, fervent):--hot.
2201: from the same as ζυγός; a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together):--yoke, pair.
2202: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as ζυγός; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.
2203: of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name , which is otherwise obsolete; Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks:--Jupiter.
2204: a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.
2205: from ζέω; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.
2206: from ζῆλος; to have warmth of feeling for or against:--affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous(-ly affect).
2208: the same as ζηλωτής; a Zealot, i.e. (specially) partisan for Jewish political independence:--Zelotes.
2209: probably akin to the base of δαμάζω (through the idea of violence); detriment:--damage, loss.
2210: from ζημία; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.
2211: probably contracted from a poetic form of Ζεύς and δῶρον; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.
2212: of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare πυνθάνομαι.
2213: from ζητέω; a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a debate:--question.
2214: from ζητέω; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme:--question.
2215: of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.
2216: of Hebrew origin (זְרֻבָּבֶל); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an Israelite:--Zorobabel.
2217: akin to the base of νέφος; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.
2218: from the root of (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair of balances, yoke.
2219: probably from ζέω; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.
2220: from ζύμη; to cause to ferment:--leaven.
2221: from the same as ζῶον and ἀγρεύω; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.
2222: from ζάω; life (literally or figuratively):--life(-time). Compare ψυχή.
2223: probably akin to the base of ζυγός; a belt; by implication, a pocket:--girdle, purse.
2224: from ζώνη; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.
2225: from the same as ζῶον and a derivative of γίνομαι; to engender alive, i.e. (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death:--live, preserve.
2226: neuter of a derivative of ζάω; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.
2227: from the same as ζῶον and ποιέω; to (re-)vitalize (literally or figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.
2228: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially ἤδη, ἤπερ, ἤτοι.
2229: an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of ἤ; used only (in the New Testament) before μέν; assuredly:--surely.
2230: from ἡγεμών; to act as ruler:--be governor.
2231: from ἡγεμών; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.
2232: from ἡγέομαι; a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province:--governor, prince, ruler.
2233: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of ἄγω; to lead, i.e. command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e. consider:--account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.
2234: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή; sweetly, i.e. (figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.
2235: apparently from ἤ (or possibly ἦ) and δή; even now:--already, (even) now (already), by this time.
2236: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as ἡδέως; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.
2237: from (to please); sensual delight; by implication, desire:--lust, pleasure.
2238: neuter of the compound of the same as ἡδέως and ὀσμή; a sweet-scented plant, i.e. mint:--mint.
2239: a strengthened form of ἔθος; usage, i.e. (plural) moral habits:--manners.
2240: a primary verb; to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively):--come.
2241: of Hebrew origin (אֵל with pronominal suffix); my God:-- Eli.
2242: of Hebrew origin (עֵלִי); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.
2243: of Hebrew origin (אֵלִיָּה); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.
2244: from the same as ἡλίκος; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.
2245: from (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age); as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much:--how (what) great.
2246: from (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of αἱρέομαι); the sun; by implication, light:--+ east, sun.
2247: of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.
2248: accusative case plural of ἐγώ; us:--our, us, we.
2249: nominative plural of ἐγώ; we (only used when emphatic):--us, we (ourselves).
2250: feminine (with ὥρα implied) of a derivative of (to sit; akin to the base of ἑδραῖος) meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.
2251: from θνητός; our:--our, your (by a different reading).
2252: a prolonged form of ἦν; I was:--be, was. (Sometimes unexpressed).
2253: from a presumed compound of the base of ἥμισυ and θνήσκω; half dead, i.e. entirely exhausted:--half dead.
2254: dative case plural of ἐγώ; to (or for, with, by) us:--our, (for) us, we.
2255: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to ἅμα (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as noun) half:--half.
2256: from the base of ἥμισυ and ὥρα; a half-hour:--half an hour.
2257: genitive case plural of ἐγώ; of (or from) us:--our (company), us, we.
2258: imperfect of εἰμί; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.
2259: of uncertain affinity; at which time:--when.
2260: from ἤ and περ; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.
2261: probably from ἔπος; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.
2262: of Hebrew origin (עֵר); Er, an Israelite:--Er.
2263: perhaps by transposition from ἔρημος (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.
2264: compound of (a "hero") and εἶδος; heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings:--Herod.
2265: plural of a derivative of Ἡρώδης; Herodians, i.e. partisans of Herod:--Herodians.
2266: from Ἡρώδης; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.
2268: of Hebrew origin (יְשַׁעְיָה); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.
2269: of Hebrew origin (עֵשָׂו); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.
2270: from the same as ἡσύχιος; to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech:--cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.
2271: feminine of ἡσύχιος; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or language:--quietness, silence.
2272: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of ἑδραῖος and perhaps ἔχω; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.
2273: from ἤ and τοί; either indeed:--whether.
2274: from the same as ἥττον; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.
2275: from ἡττάω; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.
2276: neuter of comparative of (slightly) used for that of κακός; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.
2277: third person singular imperative of εἰμί; let him (or it) be:--let … be.
2278: from ἦχος; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.
2279: of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.
2280: of uncertain origin; Thaddæus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddæus.
2281: probably prolonged from ἅλς; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.
2282: probably akin to (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.
2283: of Hebrew origin (תָּמָר); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.
2284: from θάμβος; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.
2285: akin to an obsolete (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.
2287: from (the feminine form of) θάνατος and φέρω; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.
2288: from θνήσκω; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be…) death.
2289: from θάνατος to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.
2290: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.
2291: of Hebrew origin (תֶּרַח); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.
2292: another form for θαρσέω; to exercise courage:--be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare τολμάω.
2293: from θάρσος; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare θαῤῥέω.
2295: apparently from a form of θεάομαι; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.
2296: from θαῦμα; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.
2297: from θαῦμα; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.
2298: from θαυμάζω; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).
2299: feminine of θεός; a female deity:--goddess.
